review_type: AI-assisted technical review against supplied evidence; not human researcher labels

aggregate_metrics.warning: Word overlap and citation presence are diagnostics, not correctness. Human review remains blank.

It also places money market investments under Level 1 despite source Level 2. Base also has a money-market classification error; neither is fully reliable.

Both say no pin and contact the service centre; tuned explicitly adds the supplied nozzle-damage precaution.

Tuned invents caliper removal/installation, rotor resurfacing and testing stages from a warning-only excerpt. Base is also imperfect: it frames checking/replacement as stages and adds a mechanic recommendation not stated in the excerpt. Tuned demonstrates a clear evidence-boundary failure.

conclusion: Training reported complete; mixed generation results with evidence-boundary and classification failures. Improvement in loss/overlap does not establish improved safety or factual accuracy.
deployment: Keep current model until separate export/import and actual Roadie-path validation. Preserve manufacturer procedure and missing-procedure guards.
